t: The CED photocell standalone sensor provides automatic light control for various applications. This robust, wall-mounted unit is ideal for enhancing security and convenience in both domestic and commercial settings, such as illuminating pathways, entrances, or car parks. It features a durable polycarbonate black body and opal head, ensuring reliable performance indoors and outdoors with an IP54 rating. The sensor is mains-powered and comes with fixings supplied for straightforward installation. It offers fixed time-on functionality, automatically switching lights based on ambient light levels, and supports incandescent, fluorescent, and LED loads.
